t: An open hardware Linux board with a strong built-in AI engine for camera vision.
steps: Buy the board from a distributor such as Mouser, Newark or Cytech Systems.
Get a 5 volt power supply rated for at least 3 amps.
Get an active Mini DisplayPort to HDMI adapter for a screen, or plan to use a network cable.
Follow the quick start guide on the BeagleBoard docs site to boot Debian Linux.
Blink an LED on a header pin with a short Python script.
Install the TI Edge AI tools from the docs and run one of the demo models.
Connect a camera to a camera port and try a live object detection demo.
meta: Open Board. From $186. A few stores.
